question: In February 2025, in which district did the NDRF launch an avalanche rescue operation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chamoli**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **February 2025**, the **National Disaster Response Force (NDRF)** launched a major rescue operation in the **Chamoli** district of **Uttarakhand** following a significant avalanche in the high-altitude regions.
 
• The rescue operation was necessitated by heavy snowfall and sudden temperature variations that led to snow instability in the **Dhauliganga** and **Rishiganga** river valleys. **Chamoli** is a high-risk zone for such geological and climatic events. *Hence, the statement regarding the location being Chamoli is correct.*
 
• The **NDRF** worked in close coordination with the **State Disaster Response Force (SDRF)** and the **Indo-Tibetan Border Police (ITBP)** to locate individuals stranded in remote trekking routes and border villages. 
 
• The operation utilized advanced equipment, including **thermal sensors** and **snow-probes**, to identify life beneath the snow layers. This highlights the **technical capabilities** of the **NDRF** in specialized mountain rescues.
 
• The **Chamoli** district is strategically and ecologically sensitive, housing major pilgrimage sites like **Badrinath** and **Hemkund Sahib**, making rapid response by central agencies like the **NDRF** crucial for safety and infrastructure protection.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Disaster Response Force (NDRF):**
 
 
• The **NDRF** was established under the **Disaster Management Act, 2005**. It is a specialized force constituted for the purpose of a specialist response to a threatening disaster situation or disaster.
 
• It operates under the **Ministry of Home Affairs** and currently consists of **16 battalions** (as of 2024-25) stationed across the country to ensure a quick response to various types of calamities, including **earthquakes**, **floods**, and **CBRN** (Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Nuclear) emergencies.
 
 
 
• **Geography of Chamoli District:**
 
 
• **Chamoli** is the second-largest district of **Uttarakhand** and is located in the **Central Himalayas**. It is bounded by **Tibet** to the north.
 
• The region is characterized by steep slopes and narrow valleys, making it highly susceptible to **Glacial Lake Outburst Floods (GLOFs)** and **landslides**. Notable past events include the **2021 Rishi Ganga disaster**.
 
 
 
• **Avalanche Causes and Monitoring:**
 
 
• Avalanches in the **Himalayan** region are often triggered by the accumulation of heavy snow on slopes exceeding **30-45 degrees**.
 
• The **Defence Geo-Informatics Research Establishment (DGRE)**, formerly known as **SASE**, is the primary body responsible for monitoring and issuing **avalanche warnings** in the mountainous terrains of **India**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Climate Impact:** Increased frequency of avalanches in **February** is often linked to **climate change**, which causes erratic **Western Disturbances** and rapid melting-refreezing cycles of Himalayan glaciers.
 
• **Legal Framework:** The **National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA)**, headed by the **Prime Minister**, provides the policy framework, while the **NDRF** acts as the executive force on the ground.
 
• **Uttarkashi vs. Chamoli:** While **Uttarkashi** also experienced an avalanche in recent years (notably the **2022 Draupadi ka Danda** incident), the specific rescue operation mentioned for **February 2025** identifies **Chamoli** as the primary zone of deployment.
